subject: Approval needed: Kai Emerson — upfront incentive + equity refresh request

Subject: Approval needed: Kai Emerson — upfront incentive + equity refresh request

Ben,

We need an exception sign-off for Kai Emerson (Staff Inference Engineer, team: Serving Runtime). Quick summary: strong candidate from a competitor, verbal acceptance contingent on a counteroffer. Manager (Ava Chen) is requesting an upfront incentive and an equity refresh to close.

Proposed package (ask vs. standard):
- Base: $230,000 (within band)
- Sign-on (one-time, upfront): $55,000 requested (standard band allows $20k max)
- Equity: one-time 0.5% refresh (RSU accelerated schedule suggested) — outside normal refresh policy
- Relocation: $8,000 (standard)

Rationale: counteroffer on table with retention bonus; Kai is mission-critical for low-latency kernel projects and has specific infra experience that would shorten ramp by ~6–8 weeks. Losing him would delay ship and increase contractor spend.

Attached: candidate resume and our comp comparator sheet (comp_model_q3.xlsx). Can you confirm whether we can approve or if we should escalate to VP for final sign-off? If approved, we need the offer letter updated and DocuSign link created today — candidate indicated they will sign within 48 hours if terms are acceptable.

Thanks,
Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Senior Talent Partner, Redwood Inference

Marissa —

Thanks for the context. A couple quick asks before I sign off:
1) Can you add a one-paragraph business impact statement from Ava (manager) with specific deliverables Kai will take on in Q4? I need that for the exec note.
2) Where is the budget coming from? Confirm which cost center — infra vs. platform — and whether we have headroom for the sign-on in Q3 committed spend.
3) Is the equity refresh intended to be a one-time top-up or a multi-year change in grant policy?

If we get those answers today I can probably approve a reduced sign-on. Do not send the candidate anything firm until we lock this.

-Ben
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Approval needed: Kai Emerson — upfront incentive + equity refresh request

Ben / Marissa —

Attached is the comp comparator and a short note from Ava (copied below) confirming deliverables and budget source. Budget is available from the infra hiring pool (cost center: INF-ENG-2026-Q3) — we had ~120k left after previous hires. The ask above would consume ~63k of that pool (sign-on + relocation).

Ava Chen (Hiring Manager):
"Kai will own inference kernel latency reductions (priority: persistent KV cache, continuous batching improvements) and lead the two-week optimizer project for 8.2 release. Expected ship impact: ~20% token-cost reduction for high-concurrency workloads by end of Q1. Hiring urgency: high; replacing with contractor estimated to cost $80–120k and delay schedule by 6 weeks. I support the sign-on and a one-time equity refresh as a closing incentive only. This is not a precedent for blanket policy change."

Equity note: Mina suggests a one-time 0.5% refresh as RSUs, with standard 4-year vesting but acceleration of 25% at 12 months (clawback clause if leaving <12 months). Legal would need to review clawback language; I can queue them.

Attaching comp_model_q3.xlsx for math and a draft offer worksheet in Google Docs: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-offer-worksheet

-Mina
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: Kai Emerson — limited exception granted

After reviewing Ava's justification and the budget note: I approve a limited exception with conditions. Decision summary for record (please include in the HR folder):
- Sign-on: APPROVED at $45,000 (one-time, upfront).
- Equity refresh: APPROVED as a one-time 0.5% RSU grant, standard 4-year schedule.
- Acceleration/clawback: 25% accelerated at 12 months; 100% clawback if employee voluntarily leaves within 6 months. Legal to draft clawback.
- Relocation: APPROVED at $8,000 (standard).

Conditions:
1) This is a single-candidate exception tied to Kai Emerson only — not a change to company refresh policy.
2) Offer letter must include the clawback language and explicit statement that refresh is a one-time grant.
3) Recruiting to confirm candidate timeline and pause any external outreach until DocuSign is sent.

Marissa — please update the offer and notify Legal and Payroll. Also capture this approval in the hiring exceptions tracker (sheet linked in the comp doc). I will send a short note to VP if you want formal acknowledgment.

-Ben
